title: AISHA Company OS Fleet Manifest
description: Declarative agent-fleet definition for the AISHA Company OS layer (docs/AISHA_COMPANY_OS.md). One human in the decision seat, specialized agents on the execution layer. Shared agent fields mirror plugin_catalog.agent_spec so a local agent can later be published via publish_agent / materialize_agent_runtime.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor validation.

preset.description: Informative provenance — which preset this fleet started from (e.g. one-person-company).

name.description: The human in the decision seat.

decision_seat.description: Doctrine marker: the human decides, the agents execute. Always true.

slot_models.description: Soulforge slot → Claude Code model mapping (see routerCoach.slotProfiles in .aisha/dirigent.json for the gateway-side equivalent).

defaults.description: Fleet-wide defaults merged into every agent.

brain.description: Brain files every agent reads first (prepended, deduped).

agents.description: The fleet. Slugs must be unique; at most one agent may have role=review.

claudeModel.description: Claude Code subagent model frontmatter value.

slot.description: Soulforge router slot: spark = cheap/fast, ember = balanced, verify = highest quality.

autonomyLevel.description: advisory = read-only recommendations; draft = writes drafts/proposals, never ships; execute = may act, outward actions still human-gated.

purpose.description: What the agent does — maps to agent_spec.purpose.

tip.description: Operator playbook tip embedded in the agent prompt.

role.description: review = the ship-quality gate; forced advisory and read-only.

brain.description: Agent-specific brain files, appended after defaults.brain (deduped).

outputs.description: Output contract — what the agent must return to the human.

tools.description: Tool surface. When claude is omitted it is derived from autonomy_level.

claude.description: Claude Code tool names (Read, Grep, Glob, Write, Edit, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, …).

mcp.description: Fully-qualified MCP tool names appended to the subagent tools list. Inventory them in brain/mcp-tools.md.

platform.description: Optional plugin_catalog.agent_spec passthrough used by `company-os:agent-spec` (see materialize_agent_runtime.sql).
